newsitem.title: USA: DH Technology sees Q1 below last year.
newsitem.headline: DH Technology sees Q1 below last year.

text.p: DH Technology Inc said Wednesday it expects first quarter results to be down from a year earlier because of softness in orders from some major customers.

"Some major customers have reduced orders for the first quarter of 1997," Chairman and Chief Executive William Gibbs said in a statement. "We have no indication that we have lost any of this business and believe we are well positioned in our markets for long-term growth."
In the 1996 first quarter the company reported net income of $3.0 million, or $0.36 per share, on revenues of $28.2 million.
The company did not offer an estimates for this year's first quarter results.
